models_evaluated: AI-based AAA detection and measurement algorithm

links.outcome: Initial AAA evaluation after AI detection with defined referral workflow vs pre-AI
links.effect: Initial evaluation 42% vs. 18% (P < 0.001); evaluation timeline 22 vs. 83 days (P = 0.1); long-term follow-up 45% vs. 30% (P = 0.004)
links.quote: A greater proportion of patients underwent initial AAA evaluation after implementation of AI-assisted AAA care (42% vs. 18%, P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Long-term follow-up and scheduled monitoring for AI-detected AAA patients
links.effect: Long-term follow-up 45% vs. 30% (P = 0.004); scheduled monitoring appointments 99% vs. 65% (P < 0.001)
links.quote: A greater proportion of patients in the post-AI protocol group had long-term follow-up (45% vs. 30%, P = 0.004) and had scheduled appointments for long-term AAA monitoring (99% vs. 65%, P < 0.001).
